product_id.description: Exact grouped BestPrice product id returned by search_products, in bp_<id> form.

postal_code.description: Five-digit Greek delivery postal code used to calculate shipping and total cost.

objective.description: How to rank offers. Prefer lowest_total_cost because it includes known shipping.

in_stock_only.description: When true, omit offers that are not currently available.

minimum_merchant_rating.description: Optional minimum merchant rating on a 0 to 5 scale.

limit.description: Maximum number of current merchant offers to return, from 1 to 10.
